title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-NEXT-SG-5: Add automatic retry-failure escalation: after 3 failed dispatches, reassign to alternate doer or split item, then re-dispatch NEXT-SG-5
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-NEXT-SG-5 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-LOOPBREAK-NEXT-SG-5
**Status:** closed

Add automatic retry-failure escalation: after 3 failed dispatches, reassign to alternate doer or split item, then re-dispatch NEXT-SG-5

Backlog done check: item NEXT-SG-5 has an outcome

Triage: Escalation requires modifying the dispatch loop and doer-assignment logic in Workers code; the doer cannot edit code, only the backlog DB. | first step: Write a backlog note defining escalation rules (fail-count threshold, alternate-doer mapping, split procedure) for the code change.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
